goals.name: Partner Discovery Goal Harness
goals.description: Partner Discovery Goal Harness [gtm-partner-discovery] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/hD-11-partner-discovery.yaml
goals.gate: Ecosystem map, overlap analysis, conflict screen, deterministic scores, and mutual-value hypotheses all present

gates.name: 0.1 Partner thesis declared: what kind of partner (integration,
gates.description: Partner thesis declared: what kind of partner (integration, channel, co-marketing, referral) and what gap they close
gates.command: artifacts/partner/<run>/thesis.md with partner_type enum and gap fields non-empty

gates.name: 0.2 Partner doctrine loaded (partner-ecosystem-map, partner-ops,
gates.description: Partner doctrine loaded (partner-ecosystem-map, partner-ops, joint-solution-blueprint read this session)
gates.command: grep -lq 'partner' ~/.claude/skills/partner-ops/SKILL.md && echo LOADED in session log

gates.name: 0.3 RIG coordinate stated (L1-L4; D1-D3; A1-A3)
gates.command: coordinate block in ~/.hermes/jake/partner/session-<ts>.log parseable by jq

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple H_partner declared with all 9 components
gates.description: Harness tuple H_partner declared with all 9 components

gates.name: 1.1 Ecosystem map produced: adjacent vendors, communities, integ
gates.description: Ecosystem map produced: adjacent vendors, communities, integrators, and platforms relevant to the thesis, categorized
gates.command: artifacts/partner/<run>/ecosystem_map.json — >= 10 candidates across >= 2 categories with category labels

gates.name: 1.2 Overlap analysis: candidate audiences/customers overlap with
gates.description: Overlap analysis: candidate audiences/customers overlap with ICP estimated from public evidence (case studies, marketplace listings, shared logos)
gates.command: artifacts/partner/<run>/overlap.json — per candidate: overlap_evidence array with >= 1 public source URL

gates.name: 1.3 Conflict screen: candidates with direct competitive overlap
gates.description: Conflict screen: candidates with direct competitive overlap or existing exclusivity conflicts flagged and excluded with reason codes
gates.command: artifacts/partner/<run>/conflicts.json — excluded candidates carry reason_code from declared enum

gates.name: 2.1 Scoring rubric versioned and applied deterministically: audi
gates.description: Scoring rubric versioned and applied deterministically: audience fit, integration feasibility, brand alignment, reach, effort
gates.command: artifacts/partner/<run>/scores.json — per candidate: rubric_version + 5 subscores; python3 scripts/partner_score.py exit 0 reproduces identical scores

gates.name: 2.2 Fit evidence per shortlisted candidate: >= 2 concrete pointe
gates.description: Fit evidence per shortlisted candidate: >= 2 concrete pointers (shared customer proof, complementary feature docs, integration surface)
gates.command: artifacts/partner/<run>/shortlist.json — each entry evidence array length >= 2 with URLs

gates.name: 2.3 Mutual-value hypothesis written per shortlisted candidate: w
gates.description: Mutual-value hypothesis written per shortlisted candidate: what they gain, what we gain, first joint motion
gates.command: artifacts/partner/<run>/mutual_value.md — per candidate: their_gain, our_gain, first_motion; all fields non-empty

gates.name: 2.4 Contact path compliance: outreach contacts sourced from publ
gates.description: Contact path compliance: outreach contacts sourced from public professional surfaces only; no scraped personal data
gates.command: artifacts/partner/<run>/contacts.json — per contact: source (company_page | linkedin_public | event_speaker_page); zero personal-email guesses

gates.name: 3.1 Outreach drafts personalized to the mutual-value hypothesis,
gates.description: Outreach drafts personalized to the mutual-value hypothesis, not a template blast
gates.command: artifacts/partner/<run>/drafts/<candidate>.md each reference the candidate's mutual_value entry; template-similarity check via scripts/draft_similarity.py < 0.8

gates.name: 3.2 CRM partner records created with thesis link, score, and nex
gates.description: CRM partner records created with thesis link, score, and next step
gates.command: artifacts/partner/<run>/partner_records.json — Twenty API record ids; count equals shortlist length

gates.name: 3.3 Gate-D approval before any outbound partner contact: typed A
gates.description: Gate-D approval before any outbound partner contact: typed APPROVE <run_id> recorded
gates.command: artifacts/partner/<run>/gate_d.log APPROVE line; absent it drafts remain arm: false and session ends as staged

gates.name: 3.4 Next-step tracking configured: per candidate, response windo
gates.description: Next-step tracking configured: per candidate, response window and follow-up owner/date recorded
gates.command: artifacts/partner/<run>/tracking.yaml — per candidate: follow_up_owner, follow_up_date, response_window_days

preconditions.startup_phrase: Partner discovery session. Partnerships are value exchanges, not contact harvesting. Every candidate carries a mutual-value hypothesis.
preconditions.harness_tuple: H_partner(thesis, ecosystem_map, rubric, fit_evidence, contact_path, drafts, crm_records, mutual_value, tracking)
preconditions.bms_bias: A1 for records and compliance; A2 for scoring; A3 for thesis and narrative; A4 never — partner outreach is Gate-D

self_improvement.update_trigger: same gate fails 3+ times; rubric subscore weights recalibrated when scored-top candidates consistently fail to convert

success_conditions: Ecosystem map, overlap analysis, conflict screen, deterministic scores, and mutual-value hypotheses all present
Shortlisted candidates have CRM records, compliant contact paths, and tracking entries
Drafts armed only with approval; staged-only is a complete outcome
Identity closure: coordinate, verdict (staged | approved | blocked), next safe action in session log
failure_states: stop gate(s) 2.4, 3.3: session halts; human Gate-D approval required before any continuation or outward action
halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 3.2: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 3.1, 3.4: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver
quality_criteria: Partner thesis declared: what kind of partner (integration, channel, co-marketing, referral) and what gap they close
Partner doctrine loaded (partner-ecosystem-map, partner-ops, joint-solution-blueprint read this session)
Harness tuple H_partner declared with all 9 components
Ecosystem map produced: adjacent vendors, communities, integrators, and platforms relevant to the thesis, categorized
Overlap analysis: candidate audiences/customers overlap with ICP estimated from public evidence (case studies, marketplace listings, shared logos)
Conflict screen: candidates with direct competitive overlap or existing exclusivity conflicts flagged and excluded with reason codes
Scoring rubric versioned and applied deterministically: audience fit, integration feasibility, brand alignment, reach, effort
Fit evidence per shortlisted candidate: >= 2 concrete pointers (shared customer proof, complementary feature docs, integration surface)
Mutual-value hypothesis written per shortlisted candidate: what they gain, what we gain, first joint motion
Contact path compliance: outreach contacts sourced from public professional surfaces only; no scraped personal data
Outreach drafts personalized to the mutual-value hypothesis, not a template blast
CRM partner records created with thesis link, score, and next step
Gate-D approval before any outbound partner contact: typed APPROVE <run_id> recorded
Next-step tracking configured: per candidate, response window and follow-up owner/date recorded

final_rule: No candidate advances without a mutual-value hypothesis and two pieces of fit evidence.
No contact path from non-public data; compliance is stop-tier.
No partner outreach without typed Gate-D approval for this exact run.
Every partner discovery session leaves the system stronger than it found it.
